query:
WITH deleted AS (
            DELETE FROM economy_inventory
            WHERE guild_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND item_id = $3 AND quantity = $4
            RETURNING 1
        )
        UPDATE economy_inventory
        SET quantity = quantity - $4
        WHERE guild_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND item_id = $3 AND quantity > $4
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted)
